project.title: Reinforcement Learning Algorithms Demo
project.summary: A demonstration of prominent reinforcement learning algorithms with visualizations.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Interactive demonstrations of Q-Learning, Deep Q-Networks (DQN), and Policy Gradient methods applied to classic control environments.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.body: Modular Python package separating environment wrappers, agent implementations, and visualization utilities. PyTorch is used for function approximation in the deep RL agents.

sections.title: Planning
sections.body: Implemented as a series of notebooks first, then refactored into a reusable package for easier experimentation.

sections.title: Demo
sections.body: Run the notebooks locally or view the repository.
